response.sql:
WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(`ANA Pattern`, 'NO PATTERN') as pattern,
    AVG(`aCL IgG`) as avg_acl_igg
  FROM Examination
  GROUP BY COALESCE(`ANA Pattern`, 'NO PATTERN')
),
mean_of_all_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as overall_mean
  FROM group_averages
),
kept_patterns AS (
  SELECT 
    ga.pattern,
    ga.avg_acl_igg,
    moa.overall_mean
  FROM group_averages ga
  CROSS JOIN mean_of_all_averages moa
  WHERE ga.avg_acl_igg > moa.overall_mean
),
mean_of_kept AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as kept_mean
  FROM kept_patterns
)
SELECT 
  kp.pattern,
  kp.avg_acl_igg,
  kp.avg_acl_igg - kp.overall_mean as above_mean,
  kp.avg_acl_igg - mk.kept_mean as from_kept_mean
FROM kept_patterns kp
CROSS JOIN mean_of_kept mk
ORDER BY kp.pattern;

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in ANA Pattern are labeled 'NO PATTERN' for grouping and output; the request specifies grouping them as 'a group of their own' but does not prescribe the label.

alternatives.interpretation: NULL values in ANA Pattern are displayed as NULL in the output instead of 'NO PATTERN'
